hero.sub: We help regulated organisations in government, health, and finance build the human layer that makes AI systems trustworthy, compliant, and actually adopted.
gap.left.heading: Your AI system is technically ready.
gap.left.body: It’s accurate. It’s secure. It meets your compliance checklist. Your team built it well.
gap.right.heading: But is it humanly trustworthy?
gap.right.body: If users can’t understand its decisions, can’t recover when it’s wrong, and can’t override it when they need to — it will fail in the field. That’s not a technical problem. It’s a design problem.
gap.callout: 67% of users abandon AI systems they don’t understand. 42% more helpdesk costs follow. We fix this before it happens.
services.heading: Three ways we work with you
services.s1.title: Trust Audit
services.s1.body: We assess your AI system against the four Trust Layer principles — explainability, recoverability, accessibility, and human control — and show you exactly where the gaps are.
services.s2.title: Framework Implementation
services.s2.body: We design and build the Trust Layer into your existing AI systems and processes, working alongside your product, UX, and compliance teams.
services.s3.title: EU AI Act Readiness
services.s3.body: We map your high-risk AI obligations and build the human-centred compliance layer you need before August 2026.
sectors.heading: We work with regulated industries deploying high-risk AI
sectors.gov.title: Government
sectors.gov.body: Federal agencies, ministries, and public institutions deploying AI in citizen-facing services.
sectors.health.title: Healthcare
sectors.health.body: Hospitals, insurers, and health technology companies using AI for diagnosis, triage, or patient decisions.
sectors.finance.title: Finance
sectors.finance.body: Banks, insurers, and financial institutions using AI for credit, fraud, or eligibility decisions.
evidence.heading: Built on research. Validated in practice.
evidence.p1: The Trust by Design framework was developed through independent research across 14+ AI implementation teams in the German public sector, and has been validated through advisory sessions with process management leaders in regulated government institutions.
evidence.p2: We don’t consult from the outside. We’ve built government AI systems from the inside.
evidence.strip: Framework presented to 6+ German government communities · Master’s research, ELISAVA · EU AI Act specialist
